back2basics.text: The Vande Bharat Express is a semi-high-speed train service designed to improve connectivity and reduce travel time between major cities. Agricultural modernization involves adopting new technologies, improving productivity, and diversifying crops to increase farmer incomes and ensure food security. Government schemes often support these goals through subsidies, infrastructure, and innovation promotion.

Concurrently, he addressed the Kisan Tak Bharat Agriculture Conference, emphasizing agricultural growth, farmer empowerment, and technological innovations transforming Indian farming.

back2basics.concept: Prepaid Payment Instruments and RBI Regulation
back2basics.text: Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPIs) are instruments that facilitate the purchase of goods and services against the value stored on them. The Reserve Bank of India regulates PPIs to ensure secure and transparent digital payments. RBI issues directions on operational limits, fraud reporting, and customer protection to maintain trust in the payment ecosystem.

2026-11-14-am-d2ac6ae9f3.deck: The Reserve Bank of India fined One Mobikwik Systems Limited ₹9 lakh for breaching rules on prepaid payment instruments and fraud reporting. This case highlights RBI's regulatory enforcement powers and compliance requirements in the digital payments sector.

body.label: Penalty details
body.text: RBI imposed a monetary penalty of ₹9.00 lakh on One Mobikwik Systems Limited for violating RBI's directions on prepaid payment instruments (PPIs) and fraud reporting.

body.label: Specific violations
body.text: Mobikwik allowed fund transfers by certain PPI holders to non-pre-registered beneficiaries beyond prescribed limits and failed to report certain frauds within the prescribed timeline.

body.label: Legal basis
body.text: The penalty was imposed under section 30(1) read with section 26(6) of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007.

sections.heading: What penalty did RBI impose on Mobikwik and why?

body.label: Inspection period
body.text: RBI conducted a statutory inspection of Mobikwik's operations from June 2025 to March 2026.

body.label: Due process
body.text: After supervisory findings of non-compliance, RBI issued a show-cause notice, considered Mobikwik's written and oral submissions, and then imposed the penalty.

body.label: Nature of action
body.text: The penalty addresses regulatory compliance deficiencies and does not affect the validity of any customer transactions or agreements.

back2basics.text: Electoral roll revision is the process of updating the voter list to include new eligible voters, remove names of those no longer eligible, and correct errors in details. It ensures that the electoral rolls are accurate and inclusive, which is essential for free and fair elections. Special Summary Revision or Intensive Revision exercises are conducted periodically to maintain updated voter records.

2026-11-14-am-e1693867f4.deck: The Nilgiris district administration published draft electoral rolls on November 12, 2026, as part of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process for 2027. This exercise updates voter details and is vital for maintaining accurate electoral rolls, impacting democratic governance and electoral integrity.

body.label: Definition and purpose
body.text: The Special Intensive Revision (SIR) is an exercise to update electoral rolls by including new voters, deleting ineligible names, correcting details, and updating addresses to maintain accurate voter lists.

body.label: Duration and process
body.text: In Nilgiris, the SIR runs from November 12 to December 11, 2026, allowing eligible residents to apply for inclusion, deletion, or correction of voter details.

body.label: Assembly constituencies
body.text: Nilgiris has three Assembly constituencies: Udhagamandalam with 1,89,824 voters, Gudalur (reserved) with 1,86,275 voters, and Coonoor with 1,78,741 voters.

body.label: Application submission
body.text: Eligible voters can submit applications for inclusion, deletion, or correction at designated polling station officers during working hours or at Revenue Divisional Officers and Tahsildar offices.

body.label: Special camps
body.text: Special camps are organized at polling stations on November 21, 22, and 29, 2026, to facilitate voter applications.

body.label: Deadlines
body.text: The last date for submitting claims and objections is December 11, 2026, with final electoral rolls scheduled for publication on January 4, 2027.
